description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Membership Table implementation using MySQL. It defines the MySqlMembershipTableTests class, which inherits from a base test class, and includes tests for initializing, reading, inserting, updating, and cleaning up membership entries within a MySQL backend.

classes.name: MySqlMembershipTableTests
classes.description: A test class for validating the functionality of Orleans membership table using MySQL backend. It overrides methods to create membership table and gateway list provider, and includes various test cases for membership operations.
